async function have5RawIronIntoIronIngotsTask(bot) {
    // This process checks if the bot has at least five iron ingots; if not, it determines how many more are needed. It verifies that enough raw iron is present to meet the requirement. If a furnace is not found nearby, it attempts to place one. It then searches for a suitable fuel source, such as coal or wood planks, to cover the required amount. Finally, it smelts the necessary raw iron using the chosen fuel to produce the target number of iron ingots.
